attr.title: CometStriker DX
attr.desc: CometStriker DX is a fast-paced arcade-style shooter where you boost through danger and blast everything in your way!
attr.inst: Buy and install the Linux version of CometStriker DX. Copy all the assets to cometstrikerdx/gamedata
attr.inst_md:
1) Purchase the game from [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/701040/CometStriker_DX/)  
2) Buy and install the Linux version of CometStriker DX. If you are using windows, use the following steam command: `download_depot 701040 701045 2329121753280292494`  
3) Copy all the assets to cometstrikerdx/gamedata  
4) Run CometStriker DX.sh. The first startup will patch the game to make it run on devices with 1GB RAM.
